notes.title: We're officially 50% funded!
notes.notes:
[i]Hey people,[/i]

I was away on a personal trip this weekend, but I was delighted to find out when I got back that we have [b]hit 50% of our Kickstarter goal in only a week[/b]! I want to thank all of you for making this possible, and celebrate this milestone today (albeit a little bit late, but late is better than never). 

Help share the project so we can reach our target,  and hopefully hit some of our stretch goals! You've all been wonderful with supporters thus far, so I have no doubt we'll be there in no time. Cheers!
